verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents a built-in test framework with two parts. Behavioral tests run in pytest or Vitest. Agent simulations run end-to-end conversations against an LLM-driven user and evaluate the full interaction, with judges scoring the results. This directly covers both the simulated-conversation and eval parts of the story, so developers can test before going to telephony. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that simulations and evals work as described, and evidence of simulating telephony-specific (phone-call audio) conditions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test agents with simulated conversations or evals before putting them on real phone calls

citations.quote: Agent simulations run end-to-end conversations between your agent and an LLM-driven user, then evaluate the results across the full interaction.
Behavioral tests verify specific interactions and expected outcomes. They integrate with your existing test suite using pytest (Python) or Vitest (Node.js)
Builtin test framework: Write tests and use judges to ensure your agent is performing as expected.
